title: Why Twilio Segment said goodbye to Microservices and went back to the Monolith
description: Segment was born in the era when “everything should be microservices.” They built a data ingest system to collect hundreds of thousands of events per second from web, mobile and backend apps, then fan them out…
flags: §8 'cơn ác mộng nhỏ' rendered as 'a tiny nightmare' to keep the echo of the earlier 'nightmare' (ác mộng).
§4 'modular monolith' and the quoted coinage 'version zoo' kept untranslated.
